items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: boy named Johnson was there for awhile but Austin done most of that

ctx.x: You just gave me another card of yours...from Music Town: "Spikes Brothers and McCoy's Music Town -- Music composing, arranging, vocal, recording, dancing, dramatic art, photography -- Benjamin F. 'Reb' Spikes, Lyricist, 1480 West Jefferson Boulevard, Corner Normandie, Los Angeles, California - REpublic 6211" Uh, who was the vocal coach there? I don't remember seeing a vocal...

Oh, we had a [microphone handling noise interference] boy named Johnson was there for awhile but Austin done most of that, you know. He wasn't a singer but he would coach you. You know. He'd play the piano, and if you had a song you wanted to learn, or anything, he'd sing it over with you. He couldn't sing as much as I could but he would coach you, you know [microphone handling noise]...keep you right...keep you singing right.
